en.sayed-ali-raza: Certainly, you have a fixed share and a known right in this levy,
and there are other sharers who are poor, weak and starving.
We shall discharge your rights. So, you should discharge their rights.
If you do not do so you will have the largest number of enemies on the Day of Judgement.
How wretched is the man whose enemies in the view of Allāh are the needy, the destitute, the beggars, the turned away, the indebted and (penniless) travellers.
